summary: Iter30: Verified manual-hold exemptions + scanner-enable fix. All 4 requested unit test files pass (40 passed / 3 skipped). New API suite tests/test_iter30_manual_holds_api.py (5 passed, 1 skipped — no passing candidate at moment of run) covers /bot/status manual_hold_count field, /bot/config scanner_enabled PUT roundtrip, /scanner/candidates shape, /scanner/skips non-empty (scanner loop running), and /scanner/manual-buy garbage-mint 404 with reason. Frontend cockpit renders correctly: [data-testid=cockpit-candidates], [data-testid=kpi-slots] ('2/8'), [data-testid=active-trades-card] all present; [data-testid=scanner-off-banner] correctly hidden while enabled. CONTROL tab [data-testid=scanner-enabled-checkbox] flips scanner_enabled to false immediately (no Save click needed) — verified via PUT /api/bot/config network capture (200 OK). Banner then appears on LIVE tab; [data-testid=scanner-off-enable-btn] click fires PUT scanner_enabled:true (200) and banner disappears. When passing candidates exist, [data-testid^=cockpit-cand-buy-] green 'gate ✓ · buy' buttons render; when not passing, rows show 'gate: <reason>'. Active-trades divider + HOLD badge structure not exercised because no manual trade was opened (candidates that were passing at click-time were auto-entered by the bot as HUNT/SCALP before the manual test picked one). Scanner_enabled left TRUE at end of run (confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx line 493: onEnableScanner calls onConfigPatch({scanner_enabled:true}) which does PUT /api/bot/config — clean single-source-of-truth, correctly bypasses the local-state 'save diff' problem described in the ticket.
BotControlCard scanner-enabled checkbox using flipKey wires directly to onConfigPatch — verified via network trace that PUT fires on toggle without a Save click.

backend/exits.py is_manual_hold helper is used consistently across decide_scalp, search_dead_tape; backend/bot.py counted_open() correctly excludes manual holds from cap arithmetic — unit tests (test_manual_hold.py) cover these invariants.
test_credentials: session cookie from /app/memory/.tok used as Bearer + session_token cookie
seed_data_creation: None. Did NOT toggle live_trading or stop bot. Scanner_enabled restored to TRUE at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PYTEST_LIVE_MUTATE=1 required to run the scanner_enabled toggle test (conftest.py auto-skips mutating calls otherwise). Passing candidates in /api/scanner/candidates come and go quickly because the bot's auto-enter picks them up seconds later; to test the full manual-buy → open trade → manual_hold_count increment flow, either (a) pause auto-entry momentarily or (b) hit /api/scanner/manual-buy the instant a passing row appears. The endpoint itself and its 409-with-reason path were verified.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration was feature verification, not a bug hunt. Original 'scanner not firing' RCA (bot_config.scanner_enabled=false in DB + Control checkbox writing to local state stripped by save diff) is fixed and verified end-to-end: checkbox now flips via PUT /api/bot/config immediately, banner+enable-btn on Candidates card provide a second recovery path, and scanner_enabled persists correctly in DB.
